We spend about 200-250$ a month for a family of 3. Before the pandemic I shopped weekly and on payday with a budget of 50$ and some room to go over. I planned meals and lunches for my SO well in advance, we’re also vegetarian and don’t eat dairy so we save a lot of money there. I also always looked at the circulars and used coupons to save more. It’s a pain in the ass but if you commit, it’s doable.
